LastWave

LastWave updates — Hi-Res Lossless music streaming and player for Android. Official release APKs, byte-identical to the upstream GitHub Releases, so F-Droid and Droid-ify users can install and auto-update LastWave.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:
